commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=[${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}]"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head
printenv GITHUB_ACTIONS; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---status---"; git status --porcelain

WP_BRANCH="issue-2019-let-implement-phase-1-1-cache-the-issue-body-with"
PR_JSON=$(gh pr list --head "$WP_BRANCH" --state open --json number,headRefName,createdAt,closingIssuesReferences,isCrossRepository) || PR_JSON=''
echo "PR_JSON=$PR_JSON"
if [ "$PR_JSON" = "[]" ]; then
  PR_JSON2=$(gh pr list --search "2019 in:body" --state open --json number,headRefName,createdAt,closingIssuesReferences,isCrossRepository) || PR_JSON2=''
  echo "PR_JSON2=$PR_JSON2"
fi

printf '%s' "Let implement Phase 1.1 cache the issue body with a shell redirect on the local tier" > /tmp/title2019.txt
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
cp /tmp/title2019.txt .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-2019-title.txt
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/branch-for-issue.py 2019 --title-file .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-2019-title.txt
wc -c skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md; echo "---ceiling check---"; lib/test/lint-reference-size.py 2>&1 | grep -i "phase-1-setup\|ceiling\|61" | head -5 || echo "(no direct output)"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2043/33036096737-1
git diff "origin/main...HEAD" | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2043/33036096737-1/diff.patch >/dev/null
grep -c '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2043/33036096737-1/diff.patch
echo "displaced:"; : > .prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt; wc -l < .prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
